generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
any Mis Print in Unit /Rate Please read as per KPWD SER
Unsuccessful bidder EMD Shall be paid after evaluation of Tender

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

To Qualify for award of this contract the Tenderer must have valid Class II & Above Contractors Registration Certificate, registered in KPWD / MES / CPWD as on the Date of Tender Notification. Scanned copy of Valid contractors Registration Certificate.

To Qualify for award of this contract the tenderer, as a prime contractor, should have in his name Satisfactorily completed at least Any One Single ETP Work/Building Work Costing not less than Rs.10.08Lakhs. The work should have been commenced and completed in any year during the last five financial years (i.e from 01-04-2021 till date of submission) i.e the work must have commenced on or after 01-04-2021 and completed till the date of submission of tender. Note: The work done certificate shall clearly mention the date of commencement & date of completion, otherwise it will not be considered.

To Qualify for award of this contract the tenderer in his name should have, in the last five financial years ( i.e. during the years2021-2022 , 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs.23.80Lakhs (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only ).Scanned copy of audited profit / loss statement of at least two financial years in which minimum financial turnover of Rs.23.80 Lakhs. is achieved . (Certified by Auditor/Chartered Accountant only. Statement issued by others will not qualify for Eligibility).

To Qualify for award of this contract the assessed available tender capacity of the tenderer should be more than the amount put to tender.Note: The bid capacity of the tenderer is calculated based on the formula. Assessed Available Tender Capacity (Ax N x 2.5) B) WhereA Maximum value of Civil Engineering works, (updated to the financial year of Tender invited), executed in any one year during the last five years. (Completed as well as works in progress)B Value at price level (updated to the financial year of tender invited) of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed during the next two years.N Number of years prescribed for completion of the work for which tender is invited.2.5 Multiplying factor for Regular tendersThe Bidder/Contractor must also submit Turnover details of any one financial year of the last 5 years (maximum value) (during the year 2021-2022 , 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) duly certified by Tax Auditor / Chartered Accountant for calculation of Bid Capacity. Tenders which are not Accompanied with turnover certificate will be Rejected.The Bidder/Contractor must submit details of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed in the prescribed format only (Annexure-B). Details of the works which have been completed and final bill is yet to be settled should also be provided.In Case the Bidder does not have any existing Commitments, the same should be indicated as NIL in the prescribed format.Details submitted in any other format or submission of document in which the Bidder himself has calculated the Bid capacity will not be considered and will not qualify for Eligibility. If Profit & Loss statement is not submitted, Bid capacity cannot be calculated and hence will not qualify for Eligibility.
